task.title: Installing HP Printer Drivers for Software Solutions

prereq.p: Ensure the printer is powered on and connected to the same network as the host computer, or connected via USB. Administrator rights are required on the computer.

step.cmd: Go to hp.com/support and search for your HP printer model.

info.p: Select Software, Drivers and Firmware from the product support page, then choose your operating system.

step.cmd: Download the full driver package for your operating system.

info.p: For Windows: download the HP DesignJet Full Feature Software and Driver (.exe installer). For macOS: download the HP Easy Start package (.dmg).

step.cmd: Run the installer and follow the on-screen prompts.

info.p: When prompted for a connection type, select Network (Ethernet/Wi-Fi) or USB as appropriate. The installer will scan for available printers on the network.

step.cmd: Select your printer from the list of discovered devices and click Next.

info.p: If the printer is not found automatically, enter its IP address manually. The IP address is shown on the printer front panel under Connectivity > Network > IP address.

step.cmd: Complete the installation and print a test page to confirm the driver is working.

info.p: On Windows, open Devices and Printers, right-click the printer, and select Printer properties > Print Test Page.

note.p: Always use the driver version that matches your printer firmware. After a firmware update, check for an updated driver on the HP Support website.
Do not install drivers from unofficial third-party sources. Only use packages downloaded directly from hp.com to avoid security risks and compatibility issues.
